title: Momcozy V2 Pro Wearable Breast Pump,Electric Breast Pump for Pumping Moms
bullets: Powerful Yet Ultra-Lightweight—Momcozy V2 Pro's Motor provides powerful suction of 288mmHg for efficient and rapid breast emptying. Its compact pocket-size design (only 0.28lb) ensures convenient portability.
Customized Settings - 3 Modes (Stimulation | Expression | Mixed modes) & 9 Levels, allowing mothers to easily find a comfortable setting that meets their current breastfeeding needs.

Pump As If No One Knows - The teardrop-shaped milk collector (each 120g/0.26lb) easily conceals within the bra and is controlled through the handheld motor. Operating at a whisper-quiet 45dB, rest assured that your baby's peaceful nap remains undisturbed while you pump.

Comfortable & Mess-Free: The unique integrated collection cup prevents milk backflow, ensuring a clean and hygienic milk collection process. The innovative DoubleFit flange structure with a 102-degree angled tunnel enables moms to lean back comfortably during pumping sessions.
Go Out With Confidence - Powered by an 1800mAh rechargeable battery, it provides convenience for on-the-go pumping and ensures multiple pumping sessions throughout the day on a single charge.
